description: Tool to list DataStreams on a property. Use when you need to retrieve data stream configurations for a Google Analytics property.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing DataStreams on a property.

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of resources to return. If unspecified, at most 50 resources will be returned. The maximum value is 200
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous ListDataStreams call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. The Google Analytics property identifier. Must be in format 'properties/NUMERIC_ID' where NUMERIC_ID is your actual property ID (e.g., 'properties/489591273'). Do NOT use placeholder syntax like 'properties/{propertyId}' - replace the placeholder with a real numeric property ID.
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: ListDataStreamsRequest

name: list_data_streams

AndroidAppStreamData.description: Schema for Android app stream specific data.
AndroidAppStreamData.title: AndroidAppStreamData

androidAppStreamData.description: Android app stream specific data. Populated when type=ANDROID_APP_DATA_STREAM
androidAppStreamData.title: Android App Stream Data

createTime.description: Output only. Time when the stream was originally created in RFC 3339 format
createTime.title: Create Time

displayName.description: Human-readable display name. Max length: 255 UTF-16 code units
displayName.title: Display Name

iosAppStreamData.description: iOS app stream specific data. Populated when type=IOS_APP_DATA_STREAM
iosAppStreamData.title: Ios App Stream Data

type.description: Stream type. Values: DATA_STREAM_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, WEB_DATA_STREAM, ANDROID_APP_DATA_STREAM, IOS_APP_DATA_STREAM
type.title: Type

updateTime.description: Output only. Time when stream fields were last updated in RFC 3339 format
updateTime.title: Update Time

webStreamData.description: Web stream specific data. Populated when type=WEB_DATA_STREAM
webStreamData.title: Web Stream Data

IosAppStreamData.description: Schema for iOS app stream specific data.
IosAppStreamData.title: IosAppStreamData

nextPageToken.description: A token for retrieving the next page of results. Omitted if no subsequent pages exist
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token

defaultUri.description: Default URI for the web data stream
